results.title: 7 Büyük Günah
results.overview: A secret murder plot at a forest cabin collapses as greed, uninvited guests and the mafia turn the night into a fight for survival.

results.title: Atopia
results.overview: The film explores the state of ‘atopia’ that afflicts Socrates in Plato’s *Symposium*. It is an aesthetic experience of stepping outside oneself, which the work conveys by depicting a musical improvisation by cellist Giovanni Sollima as he plays against a backdrop of abstract images created by directly manipulating 35mm film using acid etching, colour, scratches and abrasions. The secret relationship between the musician and his instrument is thus transposed onto the film medium, producing a synaesthetic perception.

results.title: Orpheus
results.overview: An adaptation of the myth, Orpheus.

results.title: Languid
results.overview: Amid a swirl of despondency and desire, a sudden disappearance disrupts an all-consuming romance.

results.title: Divorce of Yugoslavia
results.overview: Two friends meet to get a school history paper done, but several distractions and unfortunate situations extend the afternoon by a mile.

results.title: Что ты здесь видишь
results.overview: Upon meeting Masha, Sanya felt something other than anger and apathy for the first time in a long time. But his attempt to keep her turned into an outburst of the very aggression he was trying to escape. Now he must face the consequences, realizing that he had destroyed the most precious thing he had with his own hands.

results.title: Electro Andes: Episode 1 - The Night of the Andean Beast
results.original_title: Electro Andes: Episodio 1- La Noche de la Bestia Andina
results.overview: Two brothers join an eco-terrorist cell for very different reasons. One is driven by revenge. The other is searching for their missing grandfather.  But when ancient legends awaken beneath the Andes, they find themselves caught in a ticking countdown: destroy everything, or save what’s left of the Andes.

results.title: Change of Heart
results.overview: Maia lives with her grandmother, Nora, on the family’s conventional cattle farm, which she will be taking over. After a devastating storm, Maia’s livelihood is questioned by her eco-minded neighbors and an anxiety is ignited in her, as she starts to grasp the disturbing scale of climate change. Maia must navigate between acting against the dire future of the planet and staying true to her heritage. Maia Against the World is a heartfelt and humorous drama about generational divides, eco-anxiety and cows.

results.title: The Avalanche
results.overview: Two exes wake up trapped in a house buried under an avalanche as their bittersweet past and nightmarish future collapse into each other.

results.title: The Death of Us
results.overview: Explore the complexity of grief through a loving couple in a healthy relationship, shattered by the loss of their child during a violent home invasion at the hands of a cult. As they struggle to come to terms with their loss and its devastating impact, Casey, haunted by visions of a supernatural entity connected to their tragedy, and her partner, Danny, become entangled in the actions of the cult responsible for their devastating nightmare. Can their bond endure such unimaginable trauma? Or will their overwhelming agonised sorrow and otherworldly forces destroy them completely?

results.title: Camouflage
results.overview: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

results.title: MONDAY
results.overview: In the final minutes before oxygen depletion, deniers rant, couples combust, strangers collide - and one exhausted scientist races against time to save humanity.

results.title: Molly vs. THE MACHINES
results.overview: From a teenager's suburban bedroom to the boardrooms of Silicon Valley, this is a story of a heartbroken father's quest to uncover the truth behind his daughter's death and his fightback against how the most powerful corporations of the modern age operate.

results.title: Grad Night
results.overview: A graduation tape from the Class of 2001 captures one last night of freedom and the beginning of a relationship that will shape a lifetime.

results.title: Sendai Girls' Pro-Wrestling in Shinkiba 1st RING ~The Sky Is the Limit~
results.original_title: センダイガールズプロレスリング in 新木場1stRING 〜The Sky is the Limit〜
results.overview: Sendai Girls' Pro-Wrestling in Shinkiba 1st RING ~The Sky Is the Limit~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by Sendai Girls' Pro-Wrestling, held on March 22, 2026, at Shin-Kiba 1st RING in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: They Wait in Shadows
results.overview: Two sisters returning to their family home after their mother's death, only to confront the monsters they accidentally conjured with a Ouija board.

results.title: Identity
results.overview: During the Bosnian War, hundreds of ethnic Bosniak women were sent to specially designed rape camps set up by the military forces of the Republic of Srpska. Many of them had chosen to abort, however, some gave birth to these children. Now, thirty years after the traumatic events that led to their conception have taken place, three of them choose to disclose the truth of their origin and fight against the stigma many of them face in everyday life.

results.title: Eternal Love
results.overview: To save her family restaurant, returning chef Ting must rediscover the lost flavor of its signature dish. The true recipe, however, lies hidden in a memory she has long sealed away.

results.title: Dear Future Self
results.overview: Nico, a filmmaker, returns to her hometown to lead a storytelling workshop with her childhood friend Lori, a schoolteacher there. Lori’s pupils are asked to imagine their future selves. The children’s thoughts prompt Nico and Lori to reexamine their own decisions in life — as well as their friendship.

results.title: The Woman is Perfected
results.overview: In a destructive relationship she can’t escape, a young woman’s obsession with becoming flawless spirals into a fixation deadlier than love itself.
